messages:
roxanne: quick sync on the continuous-batcher followup — want to lock a minimal admission surface.
maria_r: proposal: admission returns queue_tag + opaque slot_token + an expected_wait_ms_est. v1 telemetry-only.
akash_k: workers ignore slot_token until canary flip. when enabled worker may call KV.Pin(slot_token). missing token -> mark exec_cold.
sam_sre: ops needs metrics and a per-queue kill-switch. emit admission_enqueues_total, admission_rejects_total, worker_execs_total{exec_cold}, warmup_attempts_total, warmup_dropped_total, queue_circuit_tripped_total.
roxanne: warmup dedupe required: local short TTL cache keyed by model+slot_prefix (~200ms) and cap concurrent warms per-GPU.
maria_r: rollout: (1) feature-flag telemetry 72h, (2) 1% canary tagging in staging, (3) slot_token warmups for canaries, (4) circuit-breaker + fastpath ramp. each step has dashboards and rollback playbook.
akash_k: implement hotpath in Rust, expose shared-memory for cheap per-worker reads, fallback RPC. target <1us.
sam_sre: rollback: flip ff off per-region -> legacy shaper; verify queues drain <5m; escalate if not. add runbook.
roxanne: agreed. I'll draft RFC follow-up with API sketch and telemetry table. thanks all.
